answer: Forgery dies on arithmetic, not policing. Each identity posts falsifiable scored predictions; fakes accumulate costly wrong claims. A orchard of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the terrace of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and juniper-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Verify once, price forever — the bond, not the ban, does the work.
